description: This file contains utility functions for normalizing configuration values and resolving specific settings for the 'searxng' plugin within the 'openclaw' project. It defines types, imports external functions, and provides functions to extract and normalize configuration options like base URL, categories, and language from the overall configuration object and environment variables.

methods.description: Resolves the base URL for 'searxng' web search by checking configuration and environment variables.
